O que buscamos  Experiência sólida em  Sales Enablement, Treinamento Comercial, Revenue Operations  ou áreas correlatas;  Histórico comprovado de  desenvolver times de alta performance  em vendas B2 B ou Inside Sales;  Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a dados — você sabe transformar indicadores em plano de ação;  Habilidade em  comunicação, storytelling e condução de treinamentos  ;  Conhecimento de  metodologias de vendas modernas  (SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale, Sandler, etc.);  Capacidade de navegar entre estratégia e operação — da construção do playbook ao acompanhamento individual. ???? O que oferecemos  Ambiente de crescimento acelerado, dinâmico e com  liberdade para criar e inovar  ;  Remuneração atrativa ( fixo + variável + bônus por performance );  Day off  no aniversário e na mudança de casa/apartamento;  Cartão Flash  multibenefícios;  Premiação por indicação  de profissionais contratados;  Vale transporte  e plano de desenvolvimento profissional. ???? Nosso propósito  Acreditamos que  vender é um ato de transformação  — e que equipes bem treinadas e alinhadas podem mudar o destino de milhares de empreendedores.  Se você é movido(a) por propósito, desenvolvimento e performance, venha fazer história com a gente.   Seu lugar é na Ds Marketing.

title: Especialista em ia e business intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!
Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.
ComoEspecialista em IA e Business Intelligence, sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.
O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.Responsabilidades:Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.Requisitos e Perfil:Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/Look ML, publicação);
Inglês técnico;
Interesse por cybersecurity.Diferenciais:Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
Projetos com LLMs, Lang Chain, RAG ou chatbots;
Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou Saa S B2 B.
Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.Sobre a UPX:Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.
Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDo S, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.
Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.
Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.Saiba mais:Siga a gente nas redes sociais:

Every day we are inspired by our purpose:“we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress”, achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as aAccounting Leadfor our office inCampinas, Brazil.YOUR MISSION
Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.WHAT YOU’LL DOBank Management
Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
Prepare bank reconciliations.Third-Party Management
Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.Credit and Commercial Control
Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
Control and monitor customer credit lines.Inventory Management
Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)
Control recorded fixed assets.
Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.Payroll Management
Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.General Accounting
Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
Manage accounting structures and taxes.
Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.Other Routine Activities
Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
Monitor and follow up on internal control.
Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
Prepare employment certificates.
Fill out forms for supplier registration.
Follow up on requirements from control entities.
Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED
Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
Advanced proficiency in Excel
Desirable use of Odoo
Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.WE OFFER:
Permanent hiring
Working day: Monday to Friday
Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learningAtSQM Iodine Plant Nutritionwe are committed to theInclusion Law (Law N°21.015), so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end node.js
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!
Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando Type Script e Express.
Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (My SQL, Postgre SQL) e/ou No SQL (Mongo DB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
Utilizar ORMs como Type ORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (Git Flow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, Dev Ops, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.Resquisitos:
Experiência sólida com Node.js e Type Script, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
Uso de Express (ou Nest JS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: My SQL ou Postgre SQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com Graph QL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
Git Profundo: workflows Git Flow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.Habilidades:Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, Code Igniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
Frameworks Node.js avançados: Nest JS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): conhecimento em Terraform ou Cloud Formation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, Open Telemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, Rabbit MQ, AWS SNS/SQS, Web Sockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/Type Script, integração com Dynamo DB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).Benefícios:

title: Human resources manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:Talent Development & Retention
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).Attracting & Retaining Talent
Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture
Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.Compliance and Child Protection
Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.Wellbeing
Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.Health (physical and mental/emotional)
Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.Other duties, as assigned.POSITION REQUIREMENTSBA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
5+ years of experience
HR policies, procedures, and best practices
Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
HR Information Systems (HRIS)
Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
Professional development and training frameworks
Child protection and safeguarding protocols
Cultural competence and sensitivity.
Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in PortugueseOther Skills (Desirable):
Excellent communication (verbal and written)
Strong organizational and time management abilities
High attention to detail
Problem-solving and conflict resolution
Interpersonal skills and empathy
Confidentiality and discretion
Data analysis
Adaptability and proactivity
Cultural awareness and sensitivity
Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.Child Safeguarding
Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion
EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:
Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.
Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.
Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.
Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:Instructional Support and Student Learning
Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.
Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.
Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.
Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.
Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.Student Care and Learning Environment
Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.
Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).
Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Customer support manager latam
description:
The Internet of Things (Io T) is transforming our world—making it safer, more sustainable, and smarter. As a Quectel company, Acceleronix empowers customers to succeed in their Io T projects by turning innovative ideas into impactful, real-world solutions.
At Acceleronix, our customers' and employees' groundbreaking ideas drive everything we do. We take creative concepts from the drawing board to full production, delivering solutions that make a tangible difference.
Joining our team means collaborating with company leaders, and building strong relationships with colleagues who share your curiosity about connecting the unconnected. We're a team that cares deeply about our customers, values having fun, and is committed to making a positive impact in our local communities.
Role Overview
We’re seeking a proactive and experienced LATAM Customer Support Manager to build, lead, and scale our customer support function across Latin America. This role is based in Brazil Campinas and will be responsible for setting up the regional support team, defining workflows, and ensuring high service levels across technical support, commercial inquiries, and logistics coordination.
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate strategically while actively engaging with customers and internal teams to solve challenges, improve operations, and ensure an exceptional customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Support Operations Build the LATAM Customer Support organization from the ground up, including hiring, onboarding, and mentoring support agents. Define and implement support workflows, escalation paths, and SLAs tailored to regional needs. Oversee support for technical issues, commercial inquiries, order tracking, and logistics coordination.
Knowledge Management Develop and maintain a robust knowledge base and internal documentation. Establish best practices for capturing, updating, and sharing critical customer-facing information.
Customer Engagement & Escalation Management Serve as the escalation point for key customers and complex support cases. Foster long-term customer relationships through effective communication and issue resolution.
Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Product teams to streamline support handoffs and improve customer journeys. Act as the voice of the customer to influence service improvements and product enhancements.
Reporting & Continuous Improvement Track KPIs and generate insights to drive process improvements. Establish reporting cadences for internal stakeholders and continuously evaluate performance metrics.
Qualifications
Experience 5+ years in a customer support or operations leadership role, ideally in an Io T environment, telco or B2 B SAAS environments. Proven experience scaling support teams and building processes from scratch. Strong understanding of technical support, customer operations, and logistics in LATAM markets.
Skills
Exceptional problem-solving and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortable with CRM and ticketing platforms (e.g., Freshdesk, Salesforce).
Mindset: Hands-on, entrepreneurial attitude with a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.
Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of Io T architectures, including connectivity options (e.g., NB-Io T, LTE-M), device management, and cloud platforms.
Voice of the Customer & Innovation: Catalyst Act as an internal champion for customer needs. Translate feedback into actionable insights to influence product innovation and roadmap direction.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with customers, the sales team, and internal stakeholders to support customers, leveraging both Acceleronix and third-party offerings.
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
Customer-Centric Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
Location Based in Brazil, Campinas.
Schedule: This position requires flexibility to work in shifts and be on-call, including weekends and holidays, to support customers across different time zones. Availability for emergency escalations and regional coordination is essential. Candidates must be prepared to adjust working hours as needed to ensure consistent service coverage and issue resolution.
Travel: The role requires frequent travel, approximately 25% of the time, both within Brazil and internationally, including multi-week business trips as needed.
This is a role at the forefront of a fast-growing tech sector, offering high-impact exposure to Io T innovation, digital transformation, and global ecosystems. You’ll join a collaborative and innovative environment within a dynamic international team, with ample opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and advancement. In addition to shaping and scaling global customer success operations, you'll benefit from competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
Join us at Acceleronix and be a part of shaping the future of Io T.

title: Jr flavourist - savoury applications
description:
Responsibilities
Develop and formulate stable, high-performing flavour solutions tailored to savoury food and beverage applications.

Participate in technical presentations and product demonstrations for clients, showcasing flavour performance and innovation.

Strong troubleshooting abilities and adaptability in dynamic environments.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English communication, both written and verbal.
Demonstrates professionalism, flexibility, and a proactive approach to continuous learning.
About Kerry
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Consultor de matrículas e relacionamento
description:
Nosso Colégio
O Colégio Domínus é uma instituição de ensino com mais de 25 anos de tradição em Campinas, reconhecida por oferecer uma educação de qualidade, acessível e humanizada.
Nosso propósito é olhar para cada aluno como único, incentivando talentos e habilidades desde a infância até o ensino médio. Com um ambiente acolhedor, equipe dedicada e a adoção do Sistema de Ensino Objetivo , preparamos nossos estudantes para os desafios do futuro, sempre valorizando o desenvolvimento integral e individual de cada um.
Sobre a vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Matrículas e Relacionamento para se juntar à equipe do Colégio Domínus , em Campinas, SP. Esse profissional será responsável por gerenciar todo o processo de captação e matrícula de alunos , desde o primeiro contato com famílias interessadas até o fechamento da matrícula, garantindo uma experiência acolhedora, organizada e eficaz.

title: Production supervisor/coordinator - dry-mix mortar & water-based coatings factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:
1. Production Operations & Management
Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). 2. Team Management & Development
Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team. 3. Quality Management & Control
Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 4. Safety Production & 5 S Management
Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
Promote and maintain 5 S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment. 5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions). Mandatory Requirements:
College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory. Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure. Preferred Qualifications: Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

A Dexor é uma empresa com 5 anos cuja missão de apoiar líderes e equipes na construção de relações de trabalho mais eficientes e cultura organizacionais mais saudáveis sem abrir mão dos resultados financeiros do negócio.
Para atingirmos o nosso propósito, desenvolvemos métodos diferenciados e inovadores, e atuamos com palestras, workshops, aulas pontuais e programas In Company customizados, com o objetivo de maximizar o aprendizado dos participantes e trazer resultados reais para a vida profissional e pessoal.
A Dextor valoriza a Diversidade e a Inclusão e por isso incentivamos à candidatura de todas as pessoas para nossas vagas independentemente de gênero, religião, etnia, idade, orientação afetivo sexual, ter deficiência, raça ou outro marcador identitário.
Responsabilidades da vaga:

Desenvolver um calendário editorial alinhado aos objetivos de marketing e comunicação da empresa.
Definir estratégias de conteúdo com base no público-alvo e nas personas definidas pela marca.
Identificar tendências de mercado e adaptar estratégias conforme necessário.
Criar conteúdos relevantes e de qualidade para diferentes canais, como blogs, redes sociais, newsletters, sites e vídeos.
Escrever textos criativos, informativos e engajadores (copywriting), adaptados aos diferentes formatos e plataformas.
Desenvolver roteiros para vídeos, webinars, podcasts, etc.
Revisar o conteúdo, garantindo precisão gramatical e aderência ao tom e estilo da marca.
Aplicar boas práticas de SEO (Search Engine Optimization) para melhorar o ranqueamento orgânico dos conteúdos em mecanismos de busca. Fazer ajustes nos conteúdos com base em métricas de performance e feedbacks.
Publicar conteúdos nos canais digitais e gerenciar a interação com o público por meio de comentários e mensagens privadas.
Monitorar redes sociais e promover o engajamento com a audiência.
Criar legendas criativas e interativas projetadas para fortalecer o relacionamento com os seguidores.
Analisar o desempenho dos conteúdos publicados, utilizando ferramentas como Google Analytics, métricas de redes sociais, Hub Spot, entre outras.
Elaborar relatórios para medir alcance, engajamento, taxa de conversão e outros indicadores chave de performance (KPIs).
Utilizar insights para guiar decisões futuras sobre campanhas e conteúdos.
Observação importante: A vaga possui formato híbrido de 4 dias no escritório e 1 de home office, podendo ser flexibilizado casualmente. Logo, preferimos pessoas que sejam de campinas e região e que tenham tal disponibilidade.
O que te oferecemos:

Regime de contratação (CLT) ;
PLR
Plano de saúde sem coparticipação
Investimento em cursos e capacitações
Transporte e alimentação sem desconto
Dia de folga no aniversário

title: Production supervisor/coordinator - dry-mix mortar & water-based coatings factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:1. Production Operations & Management
Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
2. Team Management & Development
Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.
3. Quality Management & Control
Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
4. Safety Production & 5 S Management
Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
Promote and maintain 5 S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.
5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).
Mandatory Requirements:
College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role.Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.
Preferred Qualifications:
Prior work experience withSikaorSaint-Gobainis highly preferred.

description:
Descrição:

– Manusear cargas, seja na empresa ou no cliente, respeitando a simbologia das embalagens e preservando a integridade das mercadorias;

– Garantir que a quantidade de volumes coletados, entregues, carregados ou descarregados esteja mencionada e de acordo com o documento fiscal;

– Organizar as cargas, conforme sua documentação, praças e prioridades; Identificar e organizar as mercadorias não conforme;

– Separar os conhecimentos de transporte rodoviário de carga, de acordo com suas devidas identificações ou conforme for solicitado;

– Contribuir com a empresa, transportando, separando e conferindo mercadorias, de acordo com as Instruções de trabalho da área operacional;

– Trabalhar em equipe, realizando outras atividades sempre que necessário;

– Prestar informações objetivas e confiáveis;

– Zelar pela limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho.

– Atender o código de ética e conduta, além de atuar sobre os mais rígidos limites de Compliance, em conformidade com todas as leis vigentes, normas regulamentadoras e políticas internas;

– Compromisso no atendimento dos requisitos das certificações de qualidade e ambientais de referência, tais como ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e SASSMAQ.

Quando atuando em Armazéns:

– Carregamento e descarregamento de cargas. Enlonamento e desenlonamento de caminhões.

– Recolher as embalagens ou resíduos provenientes da operação do ambiente de trabalho.

– Zelar pela carga do cliente, observando se estão alinhadas no lote, com os topos cobertos, se não estão riscos de tombamento ou avariadas.

– Realizar o retrabalho de transferência de produto avariado para uma embalagem para outra.

– Após a desova de contêineres píer ou para caminhão, é necessário varrer a unidade, retirar os pregos que encontrados no assoalho etc.

– Recolher resíduo de desova (madeira, plástico, papelão, cintas etc.) e colocar em local adequado conforme as orientações de reciclagens.

– Manter o armazém e o local sempre limpo, relatando na planilha ou relatório interno a limpeza o serviço efetuado.

– Realizar, eventualmente, pinturas em piso, paredes, utilizando todos EPIs adicionais necessários para a atividade.

– Realizar atividades que envolvam ferramentas ou equipamentos manuais leves, que estejam em condições de uso (material original e de procedência).

– Respeitar todas as Diretrizes de SSMA e Qualidade.

title: Gerente de Dados, Inteligência e Gestão do Conhecimento (Setor Social)
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

A Fundação FEAC é uma organização da sociedade civil, com sede em Campinas/SP, que há mais de seis décadas atua na promoção da equidade e do desenvolvimento social sustentável.

O Gerente de Dados, Inteligência e Gestão do Conhecimento será responsável por liderar e executar a estratégia de dados, inteligência e gestão do conhecimento da organização. O profissional deverá assegurar que a coleta, o armazenamento, a análise, a sistematização e a disseminação das informações e aprendizados estejam alinhadas à missão social. Sua atuação terá foco tanto no monitoramento contínuo e avaliação de impacto dos projetos sociais, quanto na transformação desse acervo em conhecimento estratégico, que fortaleça a tomada de decisão da própria instituição, de seus parceiros e do ecossistema do terceiro setor.

Além de gerar dados e evidências sobre o impacto das atividades internas, deverá promover e compartilhar conhecimento com públicos internos e externos, por meio de repositórios digitais, publicações, seminários, comunidades de prática e articulações institucionais. O objetivo é consolidar a organização como referência em produção e difusão de inteligência aplicada ao impacto social.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E REQUISITOS

Estratégia e Governança de Dados

  • Definir e implementar a política de dados da organização, incluindo governança, segurança, privacidade (em conformidade com a LGPD) e qualidade.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada a dados, estimulando o uso estratégico de informações para aprimorar a atuação social.
  • Garantir que os processos de coleta, tratamento e análise estejam integrados ao ciclo de decisão institucional.

Gestão Estratégica do Observatório

  • Definir a agenda de pesquisa e os temas prioritários de análise de dados, alinhados à missão e às necessidades do ecossistema social.
  • Desenvolver a visão estratégica do observatório como hub de conhecimento, advocacy e capacitação para o terceiro setor.
  • Garantir a transparência, a acessibilidade e a credibilidade das análises e publicações.

Monitoramento e Avaliação (MA) de Projetos

  • Estruturar e gerenciar metodologias de monitoramento e avaliação, incluindo indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas de impacto.
  • Supervisionar processos de coleta de dados durante a execução dos projetos (avaliação de processo).
  • Realizar análises de impacto, avaliando alcance de objetivos e mudanças sociais geradas.
  • Monitorar perfil, necessidades e nível de satisfação dos beneficiários, assegurando aderência ao público-alvo.

Análise de Dados e Relatórios de Impacto

  • Aplicar técnicas estatísticas e de modelagem para identificar padrões, correlações e tendências.
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados estruturados e integrados.
  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e tecnologias para análise de dados.
  • Produzir relatórios de impacto social claros e orientados a diferentes stakeholders (poder público, conselho, parceiros, comunidade).
  • Desenvolver dashboards e visualizações acessíveis para apoiar decisões estratégicas.

Gestão do Conhecimento

  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de Gestão do Conhecimento Organizacional.
  • Estruturar repositórios digitais e bibliotecas de conhecimento, garantindo atualização e usabilidade.
  • Promover comunidades de prática e redes colaborativas, estimulando a troca de experiências.
  • Assegurar que lições aprendidas e boas práticas sejam capturadas, organizadas e disseminadas internamente e externamente.
  • Integrar gestão do conhecimento às ferramentas digitais e de colaboração (plataformas, intranets, IA).
  • Monitorar indicadores de adoção e uso do conhecimento, mensurando valor e impacto.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de inovação e aprendizagem contínua.

Gestão de Parcerias e Relacionamento

  • Estabelecer parcerias estratégicas com OSCs, universidades, órgãos governamentais e think tanks.
  • Representar a organização em fóruns, eventos e seminários, ampliando visibilidade e influência.
  • Incentivar trocas internacionais de conhecimento, quando pertinente.

Capacitação e Suporte

  • Formar e sensibilizar equipes quanto ao uso de dados, MA e gestão do conhecimento.
  • Apoiar gestores na elaboração de planos de trabalho baseados em indicadores e evidências.
  • Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e mentorias para disseminar metodologias e boas práticas.

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Economia, Sociologia, Administração, Políticas Públicas ou áreas correlatas.

Diferencial: Pós-graduação em Monitoramento e Avaliação de Projetos Sociais, Políticas Públicas ou Gestão do Conhecimento será diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Proficiência em SQL, Python, R e ferramentas de manipulação/análise de dados;
  • Experiência em Ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias qualitativas e quantitativas de pesquisa;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de coleta de dados (KoboToolbox, SurveyCTO);
  • Experiência em ferramentas colaborativas de gestão do conhecimento (SharePoint, Confluence, plataformas de intranet, IA aplicada).

Senioridade: Executive

Tipo de contratação: Full-time

Função: Administrative

Sobre a Odontoclinic

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. title: Embedded Linux Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

We develop Torizon, which is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description

As an Embedded Linux Engineer, you will be part of the R&D team developing our Torizon OS : an easy-and-ready-to-use Linux-based operating system supported on Toradex hardware and 3rd party hardware.

Your focus will be on maintaining our open source OpenEmbedded/Yocto layers, as well as keeping close contact with the R&D team responsible for maintaining Toradex BSP. You will help maintaining and expanding our automated build and tests to guarantee the high level of quality of Toradex software.

  • Maintain and add support Torizon OS for different SoC platforms (NXP, TI and more to come)
  • Keep close contact with other teams inside R&D to guarantee Toradex’s full stack approach
  • Maintain and expand automated build and test cases for Torizon OS
  • Continuously improve DevOps best practices
Desired Candidate Profile:
  • Mandatory:
    • Experience OpenEmbedded/Yocto and its best practices
    • Experience in Embedded Linux and Embedded Systems
    • Advanced Linux knowledge
    • Intermediate Docker knowledge
    • Proactive and communicate
  • Nice to have:
    • Contributions to FOSS projects
    • Contributions to Debian
  • Willing to learn:
    • How to debug OS/embedded system/software in various languages
    • Best practices on build automation and test setup (CI/CD, DevOps)
    • Writing automated tests
What we offer:
  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

We serve innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive and IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, anomaly detection using artificial intelligence at the edge, and patient monitoring systems – to name a few. Our products are directly sold to more than 3,000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Your mission is to remove friction for engineers using Toradex solutions. You’ll create technical documentation, demos, reproducible references, and automation that let customers go from prototype to production faster. You will drive our efforts to have the best technical support experience in the industry, including assisting customers through our AI-powered developer community. You’ll work closely with R&D, Product and Marketing and be the voice of developers inside Toradex.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Contribute to our self-service support through one-to-many support resources (documentation, community forum), artificial intelligence and support automation
  • Be a key stakeholder in the overall user experience of Toradex products, with a focus on software
  • Make complex technical concepts easy to understand for Toradex target customers, with a focus on our software, cloud and security solutions, like Torizon
  • Interact with customers using our support channels (email, community, documentation)
  • Help scale our support by updating documentation based on direct interactions with customers
Requirements
  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Availability to work from the Toradex Office in Campinas/ SP at least 4 days a week
  • Experience communicating about products and technical concepts in developer forums, webinars, blogs, or talks
  • Previous experience contributing to software releases or feature launches and preparing clear developer communications
  • Familiarity with Git: Managed (possibly jointly) a Git Repository with multiple contributors
  • Knowledge of programming patterns and anti-patterns
  • Experience with CI/CD

Preferred
  • Experience providing technical support to customers
  • Previous exposure to the developer community

  • Knowledge or experience of Embedded Linux as a user or system administrator
  • Previous experience working with Yocto
  • Familiarity with Docker containers
  • Able to read and comprehend hardware schematics
  • Able to work with I/O interfaces ( GPIO , I2C , SPI , UART , MIPI )
  • Knowledge of Agile development concepts
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, preferably on embedded devices
What we Offer
  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development

Desired Candidate Profile

Toradex is providing and dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about his work, and is motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3,000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

  • Feature Engineering e Stores: Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados para desenvolver e gerenciar feature stores e conjuntos de dados curados (golden datasets), acelerando o ciclo de experimentação e desenvolvimento de modelos.

  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python e conhecimento avançado em SQL .
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de processamento de dados em larga escala (ex: Apache Spark , Flink).
  • Conhecimento em orquestradores de workflow (ex: Airflow , Prefect, Dagster).
  • Vivência com ecossistemas de dados em nuvem (AWS , GCP ou Azure ), utilizando serviços como S3/Blob Storage, BigQuery/Redshift, EMR/Dataproc, etc.
  • Familiaridade com os conceitos fundamentais de Machine Learning e o ciclo de vida de modelos de IA, entendendo as necessidades de dados para cada etapa.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência prática com plataformas de MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de Machine Learning (Scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch ).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes ).

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Backend Engineering Analyst role at Sinch .

Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

As a senior backend engineer, you will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global‑scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities
  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment—we don’t build software alone!
Requirements
  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.
We are looking for people who:
  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.
Nice to have
  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).
Benefits
  • Stay healthy : We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.

  • Family first : Our Sinchers enjoy 180 days of paid maternity leave, 30 days of paternity leave, and daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing : We partner with Wellhub to provide gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our partnership with Prudential life insurance covers all Sinchers for unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion : Annual reimbursements for expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break : Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with loved ones.
Hiring Process

In Sinch, we follow a fair, objective, consistent, and non‑discriminatory recruitment process. Our Talent Acquisition team, hiring managers, and interviewers work persistently to identify candidates who best fit each open position and align with Sinch's hiring needs and career expectations. Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. No mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2care. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.

title: 30/12/2024 - Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor
description:
Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sancionou a lei que estabelece um limite para o reajuste do salário mínimo, restringindo-o a até 2,5% acima da inflação entre 2025 e 2030. A medida integra o pacote de controle de despesas obrigatórias proposto pelo governo federal e aprovado pelo Congresso há cerca de dez dias.

Com a nova regra, o salário mínimo para 2025 deverá ser de R$ 1.518, um acréscimo de R$ 106 em relação ao valor atual de R$ 1.412. O número ainda será oficializado por decreto presidencial, a ser publicado nos próximos dias.

A medida busca alinhar o reajuste do salário mínimo ao novo arcabouço fiscal. Assim, os aumentos anuais serão limitados a uma faixa de 0,6% a 2,5% acima da inflação.

A política de correção do mínimo vigente desde 2023 será mantida, calculando-se o reajuste com base na soma da inflação acumulada pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC) até novembro e o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de dois anos anteriores. No entanto, o teto de 2,5% acima da inflação agora restringe a parcela adicional vinculada ao PIB.

Salário mínimo
A aprovação da lei no final do ano legislativo deverá gerar uma economia de R$ 15,3 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos. De acordo com a Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias, cada real de aumento no salário mínimo eleva os gastos federais em cerca de R$ 392 milhões, sobretudo devido à Previdência Social e a benefícios vinculados ao piso, como o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).


Sob as regras anteriores, o salário mínimo de 2025 seria de aproximadamente R$ 1.528, considerando a inflação acumulada de 4,84% e o crescimento do PIB de 3,2% em 2023. No entanto, com o teto imposto pela nova legislação, o reajuste foi ajustado para R$ 1.518.

O pagamento do novo salário mínimo começará no final de janeiro ou início de fevereiro de 2025, referente ao trabalho realizado no primeiro mês do ano.

O Gerente de Cybersecurity é responsável por liderar a estratégia de proteção dos ativos de informação da organização, garantindo a implementação, manutenção e evolução contínua das políticas, processos e controles de segurança. Atua de forma estratégica e operacional , coordenando equipes, priorizando iniciativas e assegurando a conformidade com regulamentações e boas práticas internacionais.

É o ponto focal para a alta gestão em temas de segurança cibernética, traduzindo riscos técnicos em impactos de negócio e propondo soluções eficazes para mitigação.

Liderança e Estratégia de Segurança

  • Apoio na definição e execução do plano estratégico de segurança da informação alinhado aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Coordenar e desenvolver a equipe de segurança, promovendo capacitação técnica e evolução de carreira.
  • Atuar como advisor para demais áreas, orientando sobre riscos e tendências de ameaças.

2. Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes

  • Supervisionar e priorizar investigações de incidentes de segurança, garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz.
  • Coordenar a comunicação e gestão de crises junto a stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Garantir análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.

3. Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Ameaças

  • Estabelecer processos de gestão contínua de vulnerabilidades e ameaças.
  • Garantir execução de correções e melhorias dentro dos prazos definidos.
  • Integrar threat intelligence para antecipar e mitigar riscos emergentes.

4. Governança, Controles e Compliance

  • Assegurar conformidade com normas e regulamentações como LGPD, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS .
  • Elaborar e revisar políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança.

5. Treinamento e Cultura de Segurança

  • Patrocinar e supervisionar programas de conscientização e treinamentos técnicos.
  • Promover a cultura de segurança em todos os níveis da organização.
  • Apresentar relatórios executivos com indicadores de segurança, riscos e planos de ação.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 6 anos em segurança da informação, sendo pelo menos 2 em posição de liderança.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Conhecimentos Técnicos Desejados

  • Arquitetura e protocolos de rede, firewall, VPN, proxy, IDS/IPS.
  • Sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux) e automação com scripts (Python, PowerShell).
  • Ferramentas de gestão de vulnerabilidades (Orca, Qualys, OpenVAS).
  • Segurança em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Criptografia, autenticação multifator, certificação digital.
  • Frameworks e padrões de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls).

A Ambev é uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão. Nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech trabalha para garantir que todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão sejam tratadas com carinho e responsabilidade.

Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios que inclui: vale refeição ou alimentação, plano de saúde e telemedicina, convênio odontológico, convênio farmácia, seguro de vida, instituto Ambev de previdência privada, auxílio material escolar, cesta de natal e kit congelado, empresa cidadã (licença maternidade e paternidade) e presente do bebê, desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV e abono anual referente a um salário.

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.
What we offer you
  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.
Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.
